description: Blend W 200 4 (met_source_blend) of a background met file (met-forcing.r3m: 50 km, 6-hourly, a smooth easterly flow and a broad low that follows the storm, 35 % of the track Vmax; written with tools/met_forcing.py write_r3m) and the GAHM vortex of sflow_2d_si_vortex_gahm_mpi2: defaults W 222 1 3 6 (vortex inside 3 rmw, background beyond 6 rmw), cosine taper, vortex pressure rescaled to the background on the ring (W 223 1), track taper 6 h (W 224); model time 0 = 2018-10-10 03:00 (W 203), inside the taper; 2 ranks.
